records.name: Emacs
records.summary_raw: One of the oldest text editors, free long-standing software project, with a huge amount of functionalities and extensions; implemented and extendable with E-Lisp.

records.name: joe
records.summary_raw: (Joe's Own Editor) - a compact text editor written in C, a detailed list of features and missing ones is explicitly reported on the website. This editor is mentioned in several web sources for its capability in handling large files.

records.name: nano
records.summary_raw: Easy to use, lightweight text editor; no complex keybindings to remember; the main ones are shown in the main menu.

records.name: screen
records.summary_raw: Terminal multiplexer that split a physical terminal between several processes, typically interactive shells.

records.name: iotop
records.summary_raw: "A Python program with a top like UI used to show of behalf of which process is the I/O going on".

records.name: smem
records.summary_raw: Python program that reports memory usage; it can report the "proportional set size" (PSS), a meaningful representation of the amount of memory used by libraries and applications in a virtual memory system; it has built-in chart generation.

records.name: Bash
records.summary_raw: (Bourne Again SHell) The most widespread system shell to date.

records.name: Zsh
records.summary_raw: Alternative shell designed for interactive use.

records.name: conspy
records.summary_raw: "Conspy allows a (possibly remote) user to see what is displayed on a Linux virtual console, and send keystrokes to it."

records.name: lshw
records.summary_raw: A small tool to provide detailed information on the hardware configuration of the machine. It can report exact memory configuration, firmware version, mainboard configuration, CPU version and speed, cache configuration, bus speed, etc.

records.name: parallel
records.summary_raw: A shell tool from GNU for executing jobs in parallel using one or more computers, it can split the input and pipe it into commands in parallel.

records.name: pal
records.summary_raw: Calendar for Unix/Linux systems that can keep track of events; custom, plain text storage format; interesting and fully functional.

records.name: Remind
records.summary_raw: Calendar that supports complex rules to define events and used a custom, powerful text-based storage format.

records.name: espeak
records.summary_raw: A compact open source software speech synthesizer for English and other languages.

records.name: mpg123
records.summary_raw: Quick `mp3` sound file player; no visual interface, just a command-line audio file player for `mp3` files.

records.name: ogg123
records.summary_raw: Quick `ogg` sound file player; no visual interface, just a command-line audio file player for the free and open `ogg` file format.

records.name: git-annex
records.summary_raw: Manages files with `git`, without checking the file contents into git; very useful to manage large/binary files.

records.name: Mercurial
records.summary_raw: Free, distributed source control management tool.

records.name: catdoc
records.summary_raw: Convert Microsoft Word files to plain text; output is sent to the standard output.

records.name: Duply
records.summary_raw: Simplifies the use of [duplicity](http://duplicity.nongnu.org/) by keeping clean configuration files to automate the backup.

records.name: ncdu
records.summary_raw: "A disk usage analyzer with a ncurses interface. It is designed to find space hogs on a remote server where you don't have an entire graphical setup available."

records.name: plocate
records.summary_raw: A much faster locate; plocate is a locate based on posting lists, completely replacing mlocate with a much faster (and smaller) index.

records.name: Slash'EM
records.summary_raw: Rogue-like game derived from `nethack` offering extra features, monsters, and items; includes a GUI version.

records.name: Typespeed
records.summary_raw: Type words that are flying by from left to right as fast as you can; features different word sets, e.g., UNIX commands, English words, Non-English words.

records.name: w3m
records.summary_raw: A text-based web browser as well as a pager like `less`, it can be used as a text formatting tool which typesets HTML into plain text.

records.name: Deluge
records.summary_raw: A lightweight, Free Software, cross-platform BitTorrent client; a terminal curses interface, web interface and command line client can connect to a running daemon to manage torrent downloads.

records.name: stftp
records.summary_raw: (simple terminal FTP) aims to be an "easy-to-use and unbloated client for the UNIX (and UNIX-like) console".

records.name: password-store
records.summary_raw: With pass, each password lives inside a GPG encrypted file whose filename is the title of the website or resource that requires the password. These encrypted files may be organized into meaningful folder hierarchies, copied from computer to computer, and, in general, manipulated using standard command line file management utilities.

records.name: Mp3blaster
records.summary_raw: Audio player for the text console.

records.name: dmidecode
records.summary_raw: System information utility.

records.name: scholarref
records.summary_raw: Tools to never deal with journal webpages again.

records.name: Siren
records.summary_raw: Siren is a text-based audio player for UNIX-like operating systems.

records.name: calcurse
records.summary_raw: A calendar and scheduling application for the command line. It helps keep track of events, appointments and everyday tasks.

records.name: GnuPG
records.summary_raw: GnuPG is a complete and free implementation of the OpenPGP standard as defined by RFC4880 (also known as PGP).

records.name: Bombadillo
records.summary_raw: A non-web browser, designed for a growing list of protocols operating outside of the web. Currently supports Gemini, Finger and Gopher.

records.name: GraphicsMagick
records.summary_raw: Swiss army knife of image processing.

records.name: sent
records.summary_raw: Simple plain-text presentation tool.

records.name: Aewan
records.summary_raw: Aewan is a multi-layered ASCII graphics/animation editor. It produces stand-alone cat-able ASCII art files and an easy-to-parse format for integration into terminal applications.

records.name: jp2a
records.summary_raw: Command-line tool that converts images to ASCII art in the Linux terminal.

records.name: LinuxLogo
records.summary_raw: Display the Linux distribution logo in ASCII format.

records.name: Frama-C
records.summary_raw: Open source extensible and collaborative platform dedicated to source-code analysis of C software. Frama-C can assist from the navigation through unfamiliar projects up to the certification of critical software.

records.name: cream
records.summary_raw: Encrypt and decrypt streams of data with only a master password. The key is derivated from the password + salt combo, and used to encrypt data byte per byte.

records.name: Basta!
records.summary_raw: A small amount of GNU Bash code that maintains a scroll-protected status line at the bottom of the terminal.

records.name: safe
records.summary_raw: Password protected secret keeper. Secrets are encrypted and stored on disk using a key derivated from your master password - no keys to manage.

records.name: skroll
records.summary_raw: A small utility that you can use to make a text scroll. Pipe text to it, and it will scroll a given number of letters from right to left.

records.name: sic
records.summary_raw: sic is an extremely simple IRC client. It consists of less than 250 lines of code.

records.name: GNU Freetalk
records.summary_raw: A console based chat client for Jabber and other XMPP servers. It has context-sensitive autocompletion for buddy names, commands, and even ordinary English words.

records.name: Sfeed
records.summary_raw: Sfeed is a RSS and Atom parser (and some format programs). It converts RSS or Atom feeds from XML to a TAB-separated file.

records.name: DASH
records.summary_raw: DASH is a POSIX-compliant implementation of /bin/sh that aims to be as small as possible. It does this without sacrificing speed where possible.

records.name: quark
records.summary_raw: quark is an extremely small and simple HTTP GET/HEAD-only web server for static content.

records.name: Oils
records.summary_raw: From their README: "Oils is our upgrade path from bash to a better language and runtime!"

records.name: es
records.summary_raw: (extensible shell) shell with first class functions, lexical scope, exceptions, and rich return values, based on Plan9's rc.

records.name: st
records.summary_raw: A simple terminal implementation for X.

records.name: extundelete
records.summary_raw: Recover deleted files from an ext3 or ext4 partition through its journal.

records.name: testdisk
records.summary_raw: Lets you undelete files from FAT, exFAT, NTFS, and ext2 filesystems and do many other things, e.g., fix partition tables and recover deleted partitions.

records.name: color-to-tui
records.summary_raw: Parse colors and convert them to ratatui::style::Colors

records.name: vim-line
records.summary_raw: A line-oriented vim motions library for TUI applications

records.name: termion
records.summary_raw: A bindless library for manipulating terminals.

records.name: arti-client
records.summary_raw: Library for connecting to the Tor network as an anonymous client

records.name: foca
records.summary_raw: Gossip-based cluster membership discovery, based on SWIM
